title: GraphQL Ruby
intro: GraphQL in Ruby uses the graphql-ruby gem, and the interview questions centre on three areas: the schema definition (object types, query type, mutation type, custom scalars, connections), the N+1 problem that every GraphQL implementation faces (and the graphql-batch or built-in dataloader solution that batches resolver calls), and subscriptions over ActionCable. The N+1 question is the depth marker — a naive resolver that loads associated records inside a list field fires one query per parent record. DataLoader solves this by collecting all the association IDs, firing a single batched query, then distributing results. This page covers the full graphql-ruby stack plus the comparison interviewers always ask: when to prefer GraphQL over REST for a Rails API.
